mutations.because: The org-failure guard is lowered to dead: an org purge failure no longer fails the run, so `main` resolves instead of throwing. mutations.because: A thrown campaign purge now counts towards orgFailed (`row.kind !== "user"` is true for campaigns), so `main` throws `1 org purge(s) failed...` instead of resolving. The test `main sweep still exits clean when only a campaign purge failed` asserts `await main("sweep", false, open, (line) => lines.push(line), after);` (expects resolution) — with the mutant it rejects and the un-awaited `await main(...)` fails the test.

mutations.after: const stepsFailed = orgFailed > 0 ? 0 : await after(db, log);
mutations.because: When an org purge failed (orgFailed > 0), `after` is short-circuited and never called, so housekeeping is skipped before the throw. The test `main sweep fails after housekeeping when an org purge threw` asserts `expect(after).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);` — with the mutant `after` is not called and that assertion fails.
